type RequiredFields<T> = T extends string ? { first: T; second: T } : never;
function first<T>(value: RequiredFields<T>): T {
  return value.first;
}
function firstKnown<T extends string>(value: RequiredFields<T>): string {
  return value.first;
}
function select<T>(value: T extends number ? readonly [T, T] : never): T {
  return value[0];
}
const text: 'one' = first({ first: 'one', second: 'one' });
const numberValue: 1 = select([1, 1]);
console.log(text, numberValue, firstKnown({ first: 'left', second: 'right' }));
console.log(first<string>({ first: 'left', second: 'right' }));
